8.4.5.23 EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd
[SWS_EthIf_91252] Definition of API function EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd (
uint8 SwitchIdx,
uint8 SwitchPortIdx,
uint8 Mmd,
uint16 RegIdx,
uint16 RegVal
)
Service ID [hex]
0xa7
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different SwitchIdx, non reentrant for same SwitchIdx
SwitchIdx
Index of the switch.
SwitchPortIdx
Index of the port at the addressed switch.
Mmd
MDIO Manageable Device.
RegIdx
Value to be written into the indexed register.
Parameters (in)
RegVal
Value to be written into the indexed register.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Service accepted
E_NOT_OK: Service denied
Description
Writes a transceiver register using Clause 45 access if supported by hardware or implements a
Clause 45 access using Clause 22 operations.
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋
[SWS_EthIf_00713]
Forwarding a call of EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd to Eth-
Swt_WriteMmd ⌈The function EthIf_SwitchPortWriteMmd shall forward the call
to function EthSwt_WriteMmd of the corresponding Ethernet Switch Driver (EthIf-
SwitchIdx).⌋
